instruction: Replace null ONLY with an actual measurement. Never copy a preview value and call it measured. Retain published envelope dimensions unless checked. Re-run pipe_engine.py, Rebuild-Apartment-v8.py and Export-CAD-v8.py after changes. Keep the raw measured fitting and tube combination consistent.

what_to_measure.flange_stop: Mounting face to fully seated tube end
what_to_measure.tee_stop: Upright axis to fully seated branch tube end
what_to_measure.tee_half_height: Half of measured sleeve height: 70 mm overall means enter 35
what_to_measure.tee_outer_radius: Half of measured sleeve outside diameter: 34 mm overall means enter 17
what_to_measure.tee_engagement: Sliding-tee branch: mouth to tube-end seating stop
what_to_measure.flange_engagement: Flange socket: mouth to tube-end seating stop
what_to_measure.extension_engagement: Extension socket: mouth to tube-end seating stop; check both ends
what_to_measure.elbow_engagement: Elbow socket: mouth to tube-end seating stop; check both ends
what_to_measure.extension_gap: Gap between two tube ends seated in extension 96445
what_to_measure.elbow_stop: Elbow axis intersection to seated tube end, both ports
what_to_measure.holder_wing: Post axis to wood screw centre on split end holder
what_to_measure.middle_holder_wing: MIDDLE holder: post axis to wood screw centre, check each side
what_to_measure.holder_height: End holder overall height, not plate thickness
what_to_measure.clip_height: MITTLED fitted clip stand-off from wood to housing
what_to_measure.cap_fit: Verify 96476 stopper installation on current externally threaded tube
what_to_measure.saddle_rise: Horizontal tube axis to wood underside at the saddle tab
what_to_measure.saddle_tab_offset: Tube axis to shelf screw hole, perpendicular to tube
what_to_measure.saddle_half_width: Half the strap width along the horizontal tube
what_to_measure.cross_stop: Cross centre to fully seated tube end; all four sockets must be checked
what_to_measure.cross_engagement: Cross socket mouth to seated pipe end

notes.desk_cross: This stock module requires cross, tee and elbow seating offsets to close the same geometry. Calibration rejects mismatches; reselect stock sections rather than changing pipe lengths.
